messages:
maya: Quick idea — build a tiny 'deploy-suggester' bot that recommends a change window, whether to pin the release, and a short rollback plan based on recent SLI noise + test flakiness.

ben: ooh nice, do you mean something that looks at the last 24h of error rates / rollout metrics and suggests a low-risk window? :thinking_face:

maya: yeah exactly. inputs: service name, target sha, desired latency SLO, and an optional safety flag (run-canary/smoke-tests). output: window suggestion (timezone-aware), pin/no-pin, rollback command, and a one-paragraph release-note stub.

sam: I like. can we make it a slash command so PMs can ask it too? e.g. `/deploy-suggest frontend --sha=abc123 --slo=200ms --safety=canary`

adrienne: make sure it surfaces why it picked the window. e.g. "low traffic 02:00-04:00 UTC" and "no infra events in last 72h". auditors will love the rationale.

maya: agreed. prototype output example:
```
deploy-suggest frontend --sha abc123 --slo 200ms --safety canary
> Window: 02:30-03:30 UTC (predicted low traffic based on 30d rolling avg)
> Pin: yes -> v2.4.1 (to avoid auto-roll when canary fails)
> Rollback: `deployctl rollback frontend --to-sha def456 --reason "canary-failure"`
> Smoke: run `smoke-tests frontend --suite smoke-basic` after canary succeeded
> Release note stub: "Frontend: minor perf & cache fixes. Rolling canary then full. Monitor: latency, 5xx rate."
```

ben: nice CLI output. also add a quick boolean for "force auto-rollback on X% error increase" so ops can opt in.

deploy-bot: FYI — we can hook this into the existing deploy-bot flow. If the suggester outputs a pin, deploy-bot can annotate the release note and create a preflight checklist. Would need a small schema.

sam: what about templates? If suggester detects a high-risk change (db migrations, schema change, feature flags), it should return a longer checklist template with extra manual steps.

maya: yep, risk heuristics plan:
- low: no DB migration, <= 3 changed files, small diff size
- medium: feature flags or non-breaking schema work
- high: destructive migrations, infra changes, new model weights
And mapping to templates (smoke, extended smoke + migrations, rolling + canary + manual signoff).

adrienne: also capture release-notes baseline: automated bullet points grabbed from PR description + one-line human rewrite suggestion. makes PM handoff faster.

ben: rough action items:
1) prototype CLI `deploy-suggest` (maya)
2) add a /slash wrapper in deploy-bot (sam)
3) templates library + mapping (adrienne + ops)
4) wire metrics queries and a small risk-scoring function (ben)

maya: I'll throw up a quick PoC this week. starting with the CLI that reads a few prometheus metrics and PR size.

sam: happy to pair on the bot integration. can we also add a `--dry-run` flag that outputs markdown you can paste into release notes?

maya: yes. `--dry-run` will output markdown and a suggested checklist.

deploy-bot: suggest: include `--pin-reason` and `--rollback-policy` flags so the bot stores decisions in release metadata for audit logs.

adrienne: sounds good. one more ask: make the window suggestion timezone-aware and show multiple options e.g., "02:00-03:00 UTC (lowest), 18:00-19:00 PST (acceptable)".

maya: noted. I'll keep the initial PoC minimal then iterate. posting a sketch PR in #eng-releases when ready. :rocket:
